container-query-units: Three differently sized forest-green parent container frames hold proportional arrangements of cream and terracotta component panels, with brass measuring rails. Show components responding to their own containers.
scroll-state: A sculptural vertical scrolling track with cream panels at different positions, small brass scroll markers, one glowing amber active marker, and tactile up/down navigation controls. Show the relationship between scroll position and active state.
specificity: Three groups of weighted architectural blocks form a clear hierarchy: a small single piece, a connected group, and one prominent orange block. Brass balance rails convey how competing CSS selector weights determine which style wins.
style-queries: A family of component frames contains matching inset color swatches. The inner component surfaces change in response to their own parent swatch, showing components adapting to inherited styles rather than external viewport size.
popovers-anchors: Cream floating popover panels hover above a forest-green surface, each precisely tethered by a thin brass connector to a small terracotta anchor peg. Their placement is clear, balanced, and intentional.
page-transitions: Two offset architectural page frames share a rounded orange element that travels smoothly between them. Translucent overlapping planes and a restrained curved brass motion path communicate continuity between pages.
modern-resets: An orderly foundation of aligned cream tiles replaces a small set of uneven, mismatched inherited layers. A single terracotta reference plane and precise brass alignment rail suggest a clean, consistent browser styling baseline.
subgrid: A large architectural grid contains two smaller nested grids whose brass column and row rails line up exactly with the parent tracks. Cream and orange tiles reveal alignment across nested components.
text-margin-trim: Abstract sculptural serif letterforms sit between two precise brass typography alignment rails. Translucent excess space above and below the forms is cleanly trimmed away, revealing tight, deliberate text edges without words.
flex-safe: A row of rounded cream and orange component tiles sits safely within a forest-green flex track. The final tile shifts inward from the boundary instead of being clipped, with a small brass stop protecting the content.
color-mix: Overlapping translucent discs of burnt orange, forest green, and warm cream produce beautifully visible intermediate colors. Place them in a tactile mid-century color laboratory with restrained brass supports and warm transmitted light.
smart-selectors: An elegant branching network of thin brass selector paths connects a nested family of cream component tiles. Only the matching related orange tiles are illuminated, communicating precise relational selection without code or labels.
calc-size: An expandable accordion-like architectural component opens between compact and naturally expanded states. Sliding brass measuring rails and a flexible terracotta panel convey intrinsic size that can be measured and smoothly changed.
the-layer-rule: Distinct staggered translucent cream, olive, forest-green, and terracotta planes are stacked in a deliberate cascade. Fine brass edges make the ordered layers and a single topmost winning surface clearly visible.
transition-behavior: A hinged terracotta panel is shown moving between a solid closed state and an open cream frame, with one subtle translucent intermediate silhouette. A small brass threshold marker evokes controlled entry and exit of discrete states.
